title: cig-report v1: what a family crash report carries when it leaves a machine
description: The allowlist for every product of the family (#28). `ciginstaller crash show <id>` prints exactly this object and `crash send` sends exactly this object; a field not named here never travels. It is cig's report as `cig crash show` prints it, so a report from any product validates unchanged. Free text is anonymised before it is stored and again before it is sent: the person's paths are shapes, their user and host names are gone, the family's own paths stay readable.

id.description: UTC second plus the first six characters of the fingerprint

fingerprint.description: kind, location and message with numbers removed, plus the product and its major version; never a path, user name or host

origin.description: the product that saw it, such as ciginstaller

command.description: the command line reduced to words the product knows; everything else is <path>, <flag>, <arg>, <url> or <redacted>

cwd.description: the working directory as its shape

panic_location.description: a source location in the product's own tree, or the tripwire or error code that raised it

title.description: one line for a report that is not a panic

details.description: kind-specific detail; every string in it is anonymised

repro.description: an anonymised, verified repro, when the product built one
